tools.name: inspect_item
tools.description: MANDATORY when the player wants to examine, look at, search, inspect or describe a specific object in the room. NEVER describe an object yourself - always call this function first. Match the player's description (even partial, e.g. 'the desk' matches 'The desk at the back') to the ID of the most relevant object in the current room.

target_item.description: The ID of the object in the room (e.g. 'zone_bureau', 'blouse_scientifique', 'mur_metallique'). Pick the object whose name best matches what the player said, even if worded differently.

tools.name: take_item
tools.description: MANDATORY when the player says they want to take, pick up, grab or keep an object. NEVER hand the object over yourself - always call this function. Match the player's description to the ID of the most relevant object, even if partial.

target_item.description: The ID of the object to take (e.g. 'fiole_uv'). Pick the object whose name best matches what the player said.

tools.name: use_item
tools.description: MANDATORY when the player wants to use, apply or combine an object from their inventory on an object in the room. Always call this function instead of describing the result. Match the player's description to the ID of the most relevant object, even if partial.

inventory_item.description: The ID of the object the player holds (e.g. 'fiole_uv'). Pick the inventory object whose name matches best.

target_item.description: The ID of the target object in the room (e.g. 'mur_metallique'). Pick the object whose name best matches what the player said.

tools.name: go_to
tools.description: MANDATORY when the player wants to move, go or pass to another room or area. Call this function with the ID of the destination room (see 'Open passages'). If the way is locked or does not exist, the engine will say so: narrate its answer.

target_room.description: The ID of the destination room (e.g. 'corridor_a', 'medical_lab'). Match the player's description to the name of the most relevant room.

tools.name: input_pin_code
tools.description: MANDATORY when the card encoder is waiting for a code and the player says digits. Call this function with the 4-digit code.

pin_code.description: The 4-digit code said by the player.
